summary: Intermittent Connectivity Issue During Equipment Selection
description: Sales Agent encountered an error when trying to onboard an additional location for merchant ID 12345. The system displayed a 'Duplicate Location' error message.
resolution: The access issue was traced back to a permission setting error and was resolved by adjusting the agent's role permissions to grant access to the required module.
